name: slack-project-assistant
goal: Prove one scoped Slack assistant receives channel mentions and direct messages and composes the configured QA and canvas ports without touching live services.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Prove authenticated Slack mention and DM thread routing with stubbed transports, read-only default and a separately approved live cutover. Red: Slack subscription DM handler called zero times.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Config and Slack assistant runner, channel and DM replies, scoped file and canvas operations, GitHub QA label polling and staging revision check, and a native video recipe port.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Slack DM regression: 0 deliveries on e3e3e58b35 before repair, 1 valid same-thread delivery after repair. Focused primary-Mac tests: 42 passed across 11 files, including Slack media, canvas recovery and QA deployment/event fixtures. CLI process E2E is separate on MB2.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
